content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: gpu-pool-east1 saturation. primary pool exhausted, request queue growing rapidly. autoscaler attempted scale but failed. alerts: queue_length>1200, tail_latency>2s

emily: seeing repeated `scale_attempt failed: quotaExceeded` in logs. hitting per-project GPU quota from provider. customers in eu-west1 are routed to east1 and are seeing 503s.

oncall-bot: Paging on-call for incidents. Pager: tim (primary), timeout 10m.

tim: on it. quick check: any immediate mitigation we can flip? routing policy still set to prefer primary.

raj: Autoscaler logs: `error: unable to create nodegroup: Quota 'GPUs' exceeded for project 12345 in region us-east1`. Attempted to increase max_pool_size from 150 -> 300 and request rejected. Also saw `scale_loop: backoff` repeatedly.

maria: Customer-facing note: multiple high-volume customers hitting generation endpoints. Support tickets already started. Impact: elevated latency and 5xxs for about 18% of requests for east1-routed customers. No data exposure.

emily: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enable cross-region spillover to fallback-region (us-west1) for read traffic only 2) throttle low-priority queues (batching/async) 3) switch some routes to a smaller quantized model to reduce GPU mem pressure.

tim: rolling mitigation plan: step A throttle + model fallback. Who can toggle routing policy quickly?

raj: I can change routing policy but need to ensure model compatibility across regions (kv cache mismatch risk). Suggest route only short requests (<=512 tokens) to west1.

dave: I'll prep a canary config: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/route-config -d '{"match":"region==east1 && tokens<=512","fallback_region":"us-west1","mode":"spillover"}'`

emily: good. also apply token-based throttling for low-priority by updating rate-limiter: `rl.update("batch", "qps", 10)`

oncall-bot: tim acknowledged. Estimated time to apply config: 3m.

(3m later)

dave: deployed canary routing change. now verifying traffic — 2% diverted to west1 so far.

maria: Support update: initial customer notices: 1) intermittent 503s reduced after diversion 2) some customers on long-chat workflows see context truncation when moved to fallback model. flagged to solutions.

raj: autoscaler still failing for the attempted pool increase. Filed cloud quota case: case#CLOUD-87921 opened with provider — ETA 6 hours for quota bump.

emily: next step: enable temporary throttling on non-SLA customers and push default model to `redwood-small-q4` for best-effort paths. Any objections?

tim: no objections. execute and monitor. who will change model mapping?

maria: I can patch route mapping for non-paid tiers. Will set model_alias -> redwood-small-q4 and add header `x-fallback-origin: east1-overflow`.

emily: patching rate-limiter and model mapping now (will post commands).

emily: command snippets applied:
```
rl.update("batch", "qps", 8)
routes.patch({"match":"tier:free","model":"redwood-small-q4","route_hint":"east1-overflow"})
```

(Immediate effect)

dave: queue length trending down: 1200 -> 420 in 12 minutes. tail latency improving.

maria: customer impact update: tickets with P0/P1 notified. We sent targeted emails to top 10 accounts in affected region. No SLA breaches confirmed yet but monitoring closely.

tim: good. we'll keep spillover enabled and throttling until cloud quota is resolved. Need an on-call handoff window — I'll own active mitigation for 30m then hand to raj for follow-up and cloud coordination.

raj: taking post-mitigation lead after 30m. I'll handle quota case and larger capacity planning.

oncall-bot: Tim has been paged out at 1768501500 and acknowledged.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Start timeline and incident doc: https://incidents.internal/1768501234 (runbook link).

maria: quick note: some customers reported model regressions after fallback to quantized model — we should open eval job to compare outputs and notify product for potential compensating prompts.

emily: opened eval job: eval-1768501234-quant-fallback. Will attach scoring and diff metrics.

dave: monitoring dashboards: `gpu_utilization(east1)` now 85% -> 58% post-mitigation. Request rate still elevated but healthy.

tim: handing active incident to raj at 1768501800. I'll be available for questions. Handoff checklist in thread: mitigation applied, cloud case created, customers notified, eval job started.

raj: acknowledged. I'll keep the spillover policy in place and coordinate with cloud-support for quota increase. If quota ETA slips, we'll look at longer-term options: reserved capacity + Dedicated pool for top customers.

cloud-support: we've received case CLOUD-87921. We can prioritize but need justification for emergency quota bump. Please attach peak utilization graphs and customer impact notes.

maria: attaching graphs and list of impacted accounts to cloud case now.

raj: summary for postmortem: root cause = provider GPU quota limit in region; contributing factors = routing preference to primary region, autoscaler retries without graceful degradation, lack of quick reserve capacity for high-SLA customers. Mitigation = cross-region spillover, throttling low-priority traffic, model fallback, opened cloud quota case. Next actions: 1) reserve emergency pool in 2 regions 2) improve autoscaler error handling for quotaExceeded 3) run DR test for cross-region spillover to verify model compatibility.

oncall-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Please run postmortem checklist in 48h.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked as mitigated at 1768501999.

maria: I'll draft the customer communication and postmortem notes.

emily: thanks team — nice rapid coordination.

(End of thread)
